observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show large stacks of blue plastic drums, viewed from outside only.
Many drums have orange/brown rust-like staining running down the sides, likely from the metal locking rings or bungs.
Small round bung holes are visible on the tops of some drums; no wide-mouth lids are shown.
A printed warning/hazard label (diamond shape) is visible on several drums in photo 1, but text is too small/blurred to read.
No drum shows an interior view, a close-up of a lid seal, or any marking confirming food-grade certification.
Ground is bare dirt; drums appear to be stored outdoors in a yard, stacked three-plus high.

claims.evidence: No food-grade symbol or certification mark is legible in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: No interior shot or prior-use documentation in either photo; exterior rust staining raises doubt.
Drums are stacked and photographed only from the outside at distance; surfaces are dirty, making small cracks impossible to rule out.
Only small bung openings are visible; no wide drum lid or its fastening ring is shown closed or open in either photo.

risks.risk: Rust-like staining may indicate prior storage of chemicals or oily substances rather than clean water, which would affect food-grade suitability.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the staining and the hazard label on at least one drum, legible enough to read any chemical markings.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or weak seams under grime or at the base of the drum, not visible in a distant yard shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base and seams of a specific drum, plus a video of water being poured in and checked for leaks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not leak-proven (worst case: leaking)

risks.risk: Lid/bung ring may be missing, cracked, or not sealing properly.
risks.proof: Photo of an open and then closed lid on the specific drum being sold, showing the gasket and locking ring.

risks.risk: Buyer may receive a different drum than shown, since this is a bulk stock photo, not the specific unit for sale.
risks.proof: Photo of the exact drum earmarked for this buyer, with a marker or tag for identification.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used drum from the batch, not a specific verified unit

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one specific drum's lid, bung, and hazard label, legible enough to read any text.
Short video showing the drum being filled with water and checked for leaks at the base and seams.
Clear photo of the interior of the drum to confirm no residue or discoloration.
A tagged or marked photo identifying the exact drum(s) that will be delivered to the buyer.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used plastic storage drum, but no comparable listings were supplied for this market, so no price range can be set even at worst case.
